Beats.Purpose: Capture the immediate sensory and physical reality of the protagonist's final moments as he stands in the mud, focusing on the mundane, gritty details of his environment and his own bodily state to ground the abstract decision in visceral reality.
Beats.IntendedChange: The narrative shifts from the high-level tactical decision to the low-level physical experience of waiting, emphasizing the protagonist's human fragility and the absurdity of his situation through his internal commentary on the mud, the weight of his gear, and the silence of the approaching enemy.
